Onco360 is searching for an Inside Sales Representative - Oncology. This is a fully remote position. Onco360 Pharmacy is a unique oncology pharmacy model created to serve the needs of community, oncology and hematology physicians, patients, payers, and manufacturers.

A career with us is more than just a job. It''s an opportunity to connect and care for our patients, providers, communities and each other. We value teamwork, respect, integrity, and passion.

We succeed when you do, and our company and management team create opportunities for both professional and personal growth.

Base Salary range $55k-$70k annually; plus Commission

Summary

Using a balance of account management and direct telephone outreach, the primary responsibility of the Inside Sales position will be to develop and manage a designated territory with the goal of providing education and care coordination to prescribers for all Onco360 products and services. This position acts as a single point of contact by assisting the prescriber in evaluating referrals and performing care coordination to ensure service level requirements are met. In most cases this responsibility is carried out in coordination with a mirrored outside sales representative. The targeted customers are physicians, NPs, PAs, nursing staff, office managers, administrative and pharmacy staff within both hospital and community oncology settings.

This position will be home based with minimal travel as required to execute the following:

Regional Director Major Responsibilities

  • Seeks out opportunities for prescriber experience process improvement and collaborates with Pharmacy OPS and outside sales to achieve prescriber experience improvement and sales goals
  • Achieves designated call expectations for assigned prescribers with a focus on top targets, key influencers, and pipeline leads
  • Responsible for identifying, ranking, prospecting, and developing key oncology practice and hospital-based business relationships within targeted regional territory
  • Assists with sales escalations and communicates routinely with field sales representative partner about details impacting prescriber or patient experience
  • Supports education and delivery of key messages and product presentations within initiatives (i.e. Selling our Success communication, drug launches, etc.) designed to ensure territory meets performance requirements
  • Responsible for forwarding calls pertaining to clinical information and questions (i.e., dosing directions, adverse events, counseling, etc.) to Staff Pharmacists
  • Documents and meticulously makes notations in each patient’s profile and/or CRM regarding every update and aspect of a customer’s/physician’s care or needs
  • Uses discretion and independent judgment in handling customer complaints received, while documenting and forwarding to appropriate administrative staff.
  • Obtains and manages prescriber communication preferences
  • Nurtures and manages prescriber relationship to improve loyalty, and retention.
  • Utilizes SPOC Tool to ensure all SPOC account prescriptions are processed quickly and efficiently throughout the workflow process.
  • Assists operations staff and prescriber offices with prior authorizations by following up on outstanding issues and assisting with coordination and communication.
  • Ensure that prescription renewal requests are communicated in a timely manner to ensure continuity of care when applicable.
  • Works collaboratively with sales to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals

Regional Director Qualifications

  • 2 years’ retail or specialty pharmacy technician experience preferred - Must be familiar with general pharmacy terminology, billing quantity, SIG codes, roman numerals, brand, and generic names of medications, and IV dosage calculations/day supply.
  • 2 years inside or outside sales experience for pharmacy or other health services-related industry preferred
  • Oncology sales experience desired but not required
  • Exceptional probing and consultative communication skills
  • Familiar with oncology providers, drugs, clinic, and hospital communities
  • Understanding of oncology drug reimbursement, Managed Care Medical Specialty and PBM drug benefits

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.

  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.

  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills

  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus

Job Description

The E-Commerce Marketing Manager (LATAM Marketplaces) will lead strategy and execution across Mercado Libre and other key Latin American platforms. This role drives growth through marketplace marketing strategies, campaign management, content optimization, and performance analysis, while collaborating with sales, product, and supply chain teams to ensure alignment on pricing, inventory, and brand positioning.

I. Roles and Responsibilities

  • A. Strategic Planning
  • Develop and implement eCommerce marketing strategies for Mercado Libre and other market places in Argentina, Chile, Peru, Colombia, Ecuador, and other assigned accounts.
  • Identify marketing activities that support growth initiatives on marketplace platforms
  • B. Account Management
  • Act as the primary point of contact for marketing activities for assigned accounts.
  • Manage relationships with key stakeholders to ensure alignment on goals and promotions.
  • C. Performance Analysis
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, traffic metrics, and KPIs for all accounts.
  • Ability to prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly reports and insights for stakeholders.
  • Understand customer search trends & Cricut’s brand positioning within each platform
  • D. Campaign Management
  • Plan and execute marketing campaigns tailored to each platform/marketplace.
  • Manage promotional calendar, including product launches and seasonal promotions.
  • Maintain pacing levels within monthly, quarterly, & annual budgets
  • E. Content Development
  • Oversee the creation and optimization of product listings to improve visibility and conversion rates.
  • Work closely with product marketing to ensure high-quality content
  • Manage brand stores within accounts, ensuring optimal customer shopping experience
  • F. Pricing and Inventory Management
  • Provide discovered insights around pricing & inventory to sales lead. Sales lead will own overall pricing & inventory, but marketing can provide insights from marketing-related findings.
  • Support sales with supply chain and pricing teams to set competitive pricing strategies.
  • Support sales with monitoring inventory levels to prevent stockouts and ensure timely replenishment. Monitor lost buy box % on Amazon.

Comprehensive report outlining quarterly marketing strategies and budget allocations for respective countries and assigned accounts.

Campaign Performance Analysis

Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly performance reports detailing successes, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

Optimized Product Listings

Regular updates to product listings based on SEO best practices and market trends.

Promotional Calendar

A weekly calendar of promotions and key marketing initiatives for the year.

III. Tasks

A. Daily Tasks

  • Monitor sales and traffic data across all accounts.
  • Respond to inquiries from Amazon account representatives and the third-party reseller.
  • Walk the store of key accounts & channels to ensure positive customer experience

B. Weekly Tasks

  • Review performance metrics and adjust marketing strategies as needed.
  • Audit & optimize paid search accounts (budgets, keyword coverage, cleanup, bid adjustments)
  • Conduct competitor analysis to identify trends and opportunities

C. Monthly Tasks

  • Hold strategy and performance review meetings with stakeholders.
  • Prepare monthly Amazon review deck for key accounts
  • Plan upcoming monthly campaigns and promotional activities.

D. Quarterly Tasks

  • Perform a comprehensive review of account performance and adjust long-term strategies accordingly
  • Conduct search trend audits & ad coverage analysis. Provide sales & broader teams recommended changes in ad coverage
  • Collaborating with sales prepare customer presentations (QBR)
  • Refresh product page, brand store, & advertising content throughout the quarter when necessary (creative rotations, seasonal events, updated assets)

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of e-commerce marketing experience, preferably in LATAM marketplaces like Mercado Libre.
  • Proven experience in campaign management, search and display advertising, content optimization, and marketplace strategy.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to track KPIs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Experience managing product listings, brand stores, and promotional calendars.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; fluent in English and Spanish for LATAM market communication.

Additional Information

Brazil, Mexico, or Argentina-based candidate preferred.

We’re looking for A-players—people who don’t just meet expectations, but consistently exceed them. If you thrive in dynamic environments and find joy in turning challenges into momentum, keep reading.

You don’t wait for perfect clarity to take action—you start, learn, and adjust. You believe that speed matters, especially when paired with thoughtfulness. You ask: “What can move forward today?” and push past inertia.

description:
Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

At Boulevard, our Customer Experience team is dedicated to launching, supporting, and strengthening relationships with our clients. As an Onboarding Specialist , Data Migrations , you will play a pivotal role in helping customers transition from legacy systems to the Boulevard platform with minimal disruption and maximum confidence.

You'll be the technical partner behind the scenes—transforming, cleaning, and validating data to ensure accuracy, security, and a seamless migration experience. From pre-sale planning through post-launch cleanup, you'll own end-to-end data migration workflows while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure every customer launch is a success.

What you'll do here:

Pre-Sale & Scoping

  • Meet with prospective clients pre-close to understand their data needs and align migration expectations.
  • Partner with Sales to scope technical requirements and validate feasibility.
  • Participate in customer and prospect calls as a subject matter expert on data migrations.

Data Migration & Import

  • Own and manage full-service and free import migrations from initial planning through final execution.
  • Perform imports using tools such as Flatfile and Google Sheets with high accuracy and consistency.
  • Execute structured QA and validation checks on all data prior to launch.
  • Handle migration-related CFDs/CSRs and execute bulk updates (e.g., pricing changes, contact edits).
  • Clean up migrations on launch day in partnership with Onboarding Specialists, focusing on data integrity.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Coordinate full-service migrations with teams like Odetta and Customer Operations (COPS).
  • Work closely with Engineering to manage escalations, track bugs, and improve tooling.
  • Partner with COPS and Engineering on Flatfile improvements and onboarding tools.
  • Support Onboarding Specialists in resolving real-time data issues during customer launches.

Operational & Team Support

  • Track migration timelines, coordinate launch calendars, and communicate progress and blockers clearly.
  • Answer internal team questions in shared Slack channels (#onboarding-questions, etc.).
  • Assist in data review for proof-of-concept migrations for strategic accounts.
  • Create and maintain internal documentation and one-sheets related to migrations and tooling.

What you'll need to thrive:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing data migrations or working with platform dashboards.
  • 1+ year of direct experience with Boulevard dashboard and data migrations (preferred).
  • Advanced skills in Google Sheets or Excel -comfortable with formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and structured data manipulation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving abilities under pressure.
  • Excellent project and time management—able to juggle multiple migrations simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data accuracy and security.
  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to collaborate across departments and work independently.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with Flatfile or similar structured import tools.
  • Experience with SaaS onboarding, technical support, or customer implementation.
  • Knowledge of data privacy best practices, especially around marketing consent and HIPAA customer data handling.

How we'll take care of you:

Your starting budgeted cash compensation for this role is between $64,000 - $92,000, depending on your current skills, experience, training, and overall market demands. This total compensation range is subject to change, and there is always room for growth and advancement.

In addition to the wonderful people you'll get to work with and challenging projects that'll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you're always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically.

  • We've got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance.
  • Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy.
  • Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You'll receive a work from home stipend every month.
  • Family planning resources and specialized support programs.
  • Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard.
  • Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve.

title: Technology and Product Senior Backend Engineer | Integrations Brazil (Remote)
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to our Integrations team in Brazil. This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

As an engineer, you will be responsible for developing highly scalable services and ensuring best software engineering practices are followed. You will have opportunities to participate in architectural decisions, suggest improvements, and interact with the product team and other stakeholders in a collaborative agile environment.

As a senior developer, you are expected to design highly scalable systems from scratch, deliver with minimal guidance, become an expert in the business rules and architecture of our complex environment, and mentor less experienced developers.

As part of the Integrations team, you will design and build scalable APIs, manage the integration process between Wellhub and partners (Club Management Systems), and implement new features at the Partners Portal. This team works on products such as booking and access control APIs; for example, all bookings at Wellhub use this API.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Driven to deliver timely, high-quality work. Perform insightful pull-request reviews and build reusable code for future use
  • Be data-driven and participate in and/or lead architectural decisions, share improvement opportunities, bring innovation, and keep design docs up to date
  • Interact with product team and stakeholders to influence the business
  • Ensure successful deliveries and promote long-term technical health of our journeys
  • Take ownership of critical features, accountable and proactive in following up engineering and product KPIs
  • Maintain high code quality standards, ensuring developers are proud of their work
  • Provide technical guidance for your team, spreading development best practices such as code review, pair programming, and TDD; eager to learn and share knowledge
  • Mentor less experienced developers
  • Participate in incident resolution and production troubleshooting
  • Live the mission: promote wellbeing in the workplace and create a supportive environment where colleagues feel comfortable taking care of themselves

WHO YOU ARE

  • A true team player who works toward both team and individual goals with experience in web development
  • Experience designing and developing complex modern web applications
  • Experience with at least two programming languages such as Go, Scala, Kotlin, or Java
  • Experience with SQL/NoSQL technologies (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, Redis) and understanding performance considerations
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SNS) and understanding their use cases
  • Experience implementing prototypes and in practices like MVP, A/B testing, and feature toggles for production rollout
  • Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, problem-solving, and complex analysis
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and KPI tracking
  • Experience with microservices and high-volume distributed systems
  • Experience with cloud-based architectures in AWS
  • Strong communication skills in English and Portuguese
  • Ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively
  • Self-starter who can multi-task and adapt to a fast-growing organization
  • Enjoys working on multiple priorities and projects
  • Tenacious and goal-oriented

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some benefits according to your needs.

Our benefits include:

  • WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, and mental wellbeing support. You can add up to three family members to your plan.
  • WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with personalized journeys and 52 per year of individual therapy sessions plus on-demand content.
  • HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: Flexible First company with hybrid and remote options; home office reimbursement available.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Shape how and when you work to fit time zones and personal routines.
  • PAID TIME OFF: Vacation after 6 months, plus annual PTO increments and birthday holiday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: 100% paid parental leave with ramp-back options for part-time return.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Development programs, personalized roadmaps, and internal opportunities.
  • CULTURE: A collaborative, inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other protected status.

Voluntary Self Identification

Since 2013, we've become the leading credit risk assessment platform in Southeast Asia, with over 1 billion scored customers and $800 million in loans disbursed.

We collaborate with 130+ financial institutions across Vietnam, Philippines, India, and Indonesia and have raised $100 million in Series C funding to scale our new credit cards business. Our mission is to enable credit lines for 10M+ people in the Philippines, India, and Indonesia, and we're seeking passionate, entrepreneurial, and data-driven individuals to join our diverse team.

Headquartered in Singapore with offices in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Manila, Jakarta, Bangalore and Mumbai, we're guided by values like extreme ownership, data-driven decision-making, mindfulness, and social impact. We aim to make universal financial inclusion a reality in Southeast Asia and India within the next decade, and your expertise can help us achieve this goal.

How You’ll Make an Impact

At Kompato AI, we’re reimagining the consumer credit ecosystem, and our System Administrator role is critical to making it happen. We’re hiring top talent from India (Bangalore), Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh), the Philippines (Manila), and Latin America (Brazil, Argentina, Colombia) to join our global team working US Eastern hours.

You’ll ensure the reliability and performance of platforms like Interprose, Looker, and Collin, support seamless client onboarding and integrations, and act as the first line of defense for technical issues. Your efforts will directly bridge product development and daily operations, translating our innovative AI technology into tangible business success.

By collaborating across vendors, clients, and internal teams, you’ll not only keep systems running at peak performance but also help shape their future—driving uptime, efficiency, and client satisfaction on a global scale.

What You’ll Do

System Configuration & Operations

  • Configure Interprose for live operations during US time zone.
  • Build, configure, and maintain reports/dashboards on Interprose and Looker.
  • Manage system configurations for optimal performance.

Client Coordination

  • Partner with clients and the sales team to support smooth onboarding.
  • Configure import/export file exchanges for client integrations.

Vendor Interface

  • Escalate issues and configuration questions directly to Interprose.

Support & Escalation

  • Act as the first line of system support during US hours.
  • Write clear, actionable escalation tickets for the product team (especially for issues outside US timezone).
  • Monitor system performance and proactively identify issues.

Product Collaboration

  • Share feedback and requirements for new features and bug fixes.
  • Document operational gaps and propose process improvements.
  • Test and validate system changes/updates before deployment.

What We’re Looking For

Required Skills

  • Hands-on experience with CRM/collection platforms (Interprose preferred).
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Clear documentation and communication abilities.
  • Ability to work US timezone hours.
  • Experience with file transfer protocols and data exchange formats.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2+ years in system administration, operations, or technical support.
  • Familiarity with Looker or other BI tools.
  • Knowledge of compliance requirements (FDCPA, TCPA).
  • Experience with API integrations and data mapping.
  • Background in debt collection or financial services a plus.

Why Join Us?

  • Enjoy competitive salary and comprehensive benefits that support your well-being.

title: Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program
description:
Overview

This is an international staff role based at our Headquarters in Washington, D.C. We offer visa and relocation support.

We improve lives

The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.

About This Position

The Amazonia Forever Unit has rapidly positioned itself as a strategic leader in advancing sustainable development across the Amazonia region. In just three years, it has mobilized over $4.2 billion in operations across eight countries, launched innovative financing mechanisms, including Indigenous-led funds. Coordinated the first loans under the Green Climate Fund and the Amazon Bioeconomy and Forest Management Fund. Through regional networks, knowledge platforms, and global partnerships, the Unit has strengthened institutional capacities, promoted inclusive growth, and elevated the IDB’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.

We are seeking a strategic leader to serve as Unit Chief for the Amazonia Forever Regional Program. This role is central to advancing sustainable and inclusive development across the Amazonia region, which is home to nearly 40% of South America’s landmass. The Unit Chief will lead cross-sectoral efforts, manage funding mechanisms, and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure impactful and cohesive development strategies.

This position will report to the Manager of the Southern Cone Department. It will advise and support the Vice Presidency of Countries and Regional Integration, as well as the CSC, CAN, and CCB Managers, in the preparation, development, and implementation of national and regional dialogues, strategies, and activities related to the Amazonia Forever Program.

What you’ll do

As Unit Chief, you will lead and manage the Amazonia Forever Regional Program within the Bank and its funding mechanisms and coordinate the external partners and networks that are part of the Program.

Regional Dialogues & Country Engagement

  • Coordinate high-level dialogues across Amazonia-region countries, in close collaboration with Country Representatives, to identify shared priorities and build consensus around strategic development goals.
  • Align Amazonia Forever Program goals with Country Strategies, ensuring coherence across sectors and countries.
  • Engage diverse partners and stakeholders to shape initiatives within the Amazonia Forever Program.

Operational Strategy & Policy Development

  • Advise senior management on the formulation of operational strategies, policies, and guidelines tailored to the Amazonia region.
  • Promote implementation of the program’s five key pillars:
  • Combating deforestation and strengthening environmental control and security.
  • Bioeconomy and creative economy.
  • People-centered development.
  • Sustainable cities, infrastructure, and connectivity.
  • Sustainable, low-carbon agriculture, livestock, and forestry.
  • Integrate cross-cutting themes: inclusion of women, Indigenous peoples, Afro-descendants, and local communities; climate, biodiversity, and forest conservation; and institutional capacity and rule of law.

Financing And Resource Mobilization

  • Collaborate with the IDB Global Partnerships Department to mobilize resources from donors and partners.
  • Coordinate and manage various funding mechanisms, including donor resources and IDB’s own funds.
  • Leverage Amazonia Forever’s financial instruments to support strategic solutions for regional development challenges.

Stakeholder Engagement & Community Dialogues

  • Coordinate inclusive engagement with civil society, indigenous and Afro-descendant communities, and traditional Amazonian populations in collaboration with IDB Civil Society Unit.
  • Strengthening partnerships with national and international organizations, donors, and private sector actors.

Knowledge & Innovation Agenda

  • Lead the knowledge and innovation agenda of the Amazonia Forever Program, working in close coordination with the Southern Cone, Andean, and Caribbean Departments to ensure regional integration and strategic alignment.
  • Promote experimental programs and pioneering research to support sustainable development.
  • Oversee development and dissemination of knowledge products aligned with program priorities.

Institutional Partnerships & External Representation

  • Coordinate joint initiatives with IDB Invest and IDB Lab.
  • Ensure integration of cross-cutting themes such as climate resilience, sustainability, and social inclusion within IDB Group.
  • Represent the IDB in global forums and multilateral platforms to promote the Bank’s leadership in Amazonia-related development.
  • Build and strengthen partnerships with other MDBs, international agencies, and private sector actors to support coordinated regional efforts.

What you'll need

  • Education: You hold an advanced degree (master’s or equivalent) from an accredited university in a field of the social sciences or humanities that is relevant to sustainable and inclusive development.
  • Experience: Experience related to advancing sustainable and/or inclusive development in the region.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English, and Spanish or Portuguese.

Professional Experience

  • You have extensive experience conducting strategic-level technical dialogues with diverse groups (e.g. public sector, private sector, civil society, Indigenous and/or traditional communities), including dialogues in matters related to your work.
  • Experience facilitating dialogues and negotiations that directly involved more than one country is a plus.
  • You have experience in connecting strategic-level discussions with realities at the operational level.
  • A working understanding of multi-lateral development banks is advantageous.
  • You have demonstrated understanding of the fundamental economic, socio-cultural, and environmental characteristics of the Amazonian territories within the countries that are the focus of the Amazonia Forever Regional Program.

Requirements

  • Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48-member countries. We may offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.

Type of contract and duration

  • Staff: International staff contract, 36 months initially, renewable upon mutual agreement.

What we offer

The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee's life. These benefits include:

  • A competitive compensation package, including an annual base salary expressed on a net-of-tax basis.
  • Leaves and vacations: 24 days of paid time off + 8 personal days + sick leave + gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Health Insurance: IDB Group provides employees and eligible dependents with a robust medical benefits program that covers medical, dental, vision, preventive care, and prescription drugs.
  • Pension plan: a defined benefit pension plan that provides financial security and supports employees in planning for their future.
  • We offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your family when it applies.
  • Hybrid and flexible work schedules.
  • Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center, which provides preventive care and health education for employees.
  • Development support: We offer tools to boost your professional profile, such as mentoring, 1:1 professional counseling, training and learning opportunities, language classes, mobility options, among others.

Our culture

At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.

In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job interview process. If you require an accommodation to complete this application, please email us at

description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

The Medical Director is a medical spokesperson for Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield with the provider network across NJ. The Medical Director will be accountable for providing leadership, direction and daily support for their assigned region of NJ and assigned providers; the scope of activities include, but are not limited to, utilization management, care management, disease management, quality management, pharmacy management, post service reviews, provider education, support for provider relations issues, and clinical transformation. The Medical Director is accountable for a personal caseload of daily medical management activities and contributing to operational effectiveness of the medical management program.
Medical Policy and HPIRIT only:
The position has primary responsibility for the medical review for the Clinical Inquiries Team (CIT) and support special investigations unit as needed. Also, the position supports the development and implementation of reimbursement policies.

Responsibilities:

  • Support all lines of business which includes Commercial and Government Programs.

  • Collaborate with value based teams, Behavioral Health and Pharmacy; supports accounts and activities for cross functional areas by region, where applicable. Supports sales teams as assigned by region.

  • Guides, supports and consults with nurse reviewers on pre-authorization, concurrent and retrospective review issues, post-service reviews, pre-determinations and decisions, where applicable. Consult with/support case management to determine best course for members, assist with PG and address issues.

  • Develops and maintains effective collaborative relationships with providers in assigned geographic areas. This includes on site or virtual review of performance and coaching activities with physicians, hospitals and ancillary providers.

  • May provide input into provider credentialing, profiling and communication initiatives.

  • Responsible for data analysis on case management and utilization, identify issues and escalate as necessary to senior management.

  • Interprets and analyzes available utilization, cost and quality reports and develops steps to address variances to target performance matrix. Collaborates on documentation of monthly reporting address performance, issues and activities for assigned region.

  • Assists with assessment of network capabilities by region and collaborates with network management, contracting and value based teams in addressing network gaps.

  • Creates/participates in internal or external educational activities for other members of the team/stakeholders across regional/functional areas.

  • Participates in Committee activities as assigned.

  • Assist with coverage across functional MD teams, as needed, including participation in calls for all areas.

  • Support medical policy development process, review medical and pharmacy policies and provide feedback regarding utilization to the development team.

  • Works with legal and mandate team to support Horizon’s compliance with the NJ Department of banking and insurance (DOBI).

  • Backup chair for committees with internal and external stakeholders.

Medical Policy and HPIRIT only:

  • Performs medical reviews for the Clinical Inquiries Team (CIT) and support special investigations unit as needed.

  • Support development and implementation of reimbursement policies.

  • Assist with coverage across functional MD teams as needed including participation in calls for all areas.

Functional Competencies:

  • Knowledge in the principles of Utilization Management, Case Management, Quality Management and accreditation/regulatory standards.

  • Requires broad clinical knowledge and understanding of current health care issues and climate.

  • Requires some knowledge of health insurance payer business including business operations.

Education/Experience:

  • Requires Board Certification in an American Board of Medicine recognized specialty Requires current unrestricted MD or DO license to practice medicine.

  • Requires 5-7 years Clinical Experience Experience with managing data to identify key issues, developing recommendations and providing content/conclusions to executive management.

  • Proficiency working with Tableau or similar software required.

  • Proficiency also required working with a Windows based environment including MS Office products.

  • Continuous Improvement Experience Preferred.

Specific to Medical Policy:

  • Ability to review studies, understand evidence based medicine and support medical policy development.

  • Ability to chair committees with internal and external stakeholders.

Additional licensing, certifications, registrations:

  • Active Unrestricted MD or DO License Required; NJ License Required, No CMS Sanctions or sanctions by other regulatory agencies or boards.

  • Must be board certified by a specialty recognized by the American Osteopathic Association or the American Board of Medical Specialties.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Business Acumen: Identify key issues and opportunities, developing strategies and plans and have resolute decision making.

  • Planning and Organizing: Leveraging resources, staying focused and effectively prioritizing key objectives.

  • Building Strategic Working Relationships: Proactively tries to build effective working relationships; facilitates agreement; clarifies current situation; involving appropriate individuals within team and broader organization to achieve desired results.

  • Executive Presence: Advocates for the organization, inspiring confidence among peers regarding reliability and capability, inspiring senior leadership expectations on potential for outstanding outcomes and achievements.

  • Meeting Leadership: Ensures a meeting serves its business objectives; facilitating agreement; develops others' and own ideas; closes discussions with clear summaries.

  • Negotiation: Effectively exploring alternatives and positions to reach outcomes that gain the support and acceptance of all parties.

  • Matrix Environment: Ability to function and work in a matrix environment which includes working on and at time leading cross functional teams.

  • Conflict resolution: ability to identify conflict, determine its causes and negotiate mutually agreeable solutions.

Travel % (If Applicable):

  • The position requires access to a car and the ability to travel for meetings with physicians, hospitals and ancillary providers as required.

Horizon BCBSNJ employees must live in New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Connecticut or Delaware

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter serviços e APIs back end e front end que suportem os processos de ETL e integração de dados (Java e React.js).
  • Implementar soluções de armazenamento de dados NoSQL, como MongoDB, para armazenar e consultar dados de forma eficaz.
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de integração baseados em eventos para facilitar a comunicação entre os diferentes componentes do sistema.
  • Trabalhar com protocolos FTP e lidar com arquivos posicionais para a troca de dados com parceiros externos.
  • Garantir que o sistema de ETL seja altamente observável, permitindo a fácil depuração de problemas e a monitoração de desempenho.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos e garantir que as soluções desenvolvidas atendam às necessidades de negócios.
  • Realizar testes de unidade, integração e aceitação para garantir a qualidade do código.
  • Manter a documentação técnica atualizada e participar na revisão de código.
  • Ficar atualizado com as melhores práticas e tendências em desenvolvimento back end e front end.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento back-end e front end, em um ambiente de microserviços com Linguagem Java, Spring Boot, React.js.
  • Conhecimento sólido em NoSQL, com experiência prática em MongoDB.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas ETL.
  • Experiência com Cloud (AWS, Azure).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura baseada em eventos e ferramentas relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos FTP e manipulação de arquivos posicionais.
  • Habilidade de escrever código limpo, escalável e de fácil manutenção.
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada.

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. Pensamos, em conjunto, ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como grupos de Mulheres, Pessoas com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros. title: Supervisor de Unidade
description:
Overview

Job type: Full-time employee

Se o seu propósito é inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas, você está no lugar certo!

Fundado em Brasília pelas bioquímicas Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, o Grupo Sabin está há 38 anos no mercado. Somos referência em Medicina Diagnóstica, com atuação em análises clínicas, diagnóstico por imagem, vacinação e check-up executivo. O Sabin também atua em Atenção Primária à Saúde (APS) com a Amparo Saúde e lançou, no ano passado, a plataforma integradora de serviços de saúde Rita Saúde. Somos reconhecidos no Brasil e na América Latina como uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar há mais de 18 anos, com cultura organizacional forte, respeito, desenvolvimento, diversidade e inclusão. Contamos com mais de 6.700 colaboradores, em 12 estados e no Distrito Federal, com 323 unidades.

Responsibilities

  • Planejar e administrar o trabalho da equipe, definindo rotinas, técnicas de abordagem de clientes e estratégias para cumprir metas e prazos;
  • Supervisionar todas as rotinas administrativas da equipe;
  • Supervisionar serviços gerais de malotes, mensageiros, transporte, limpeza, terceirizados, manutenção de equipamento, mobiliário e instalações;
  • Responder pelas metas e resultados da equipe, traçando planos de avanço e de melhoria contínua;
  • Monitorar os indicadores da área;
  • Planejar e desenvolver novos projetos, quando aplicável;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento, informações e metas com toda a equipe;
  • Controlar as atividades financeiras das unidades;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes, mercado e médicos;
  • Realizar mapeamento de mercado local e fechar parcerias para captação e fidelização de clientes;
  • Gerenciar o clima organizacional, proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo;
  • Promover feedbacks de forma respeitosa;
  • Sinalizar casos de baixa performance à gestão de pessoal;
  • Realizar desligamentos junto ao RH, quando aplicável;
  • Assegurar que as políticas e normas da empresa sejam cumpridas pela equipe;
  • Desenvolver novos лидеры quando aplicável;
  • Propor ações de melhoria contínua;

Qualifications

  • Graduação completa em Biomedicina, Enfermagem, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas da Saúde;
  • Desejável especialização em Gestão em Saúde, Administração Hospitalar ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento em Boas Práticas Laboratoriais, biossegurança e protocolos de qualidade;
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos em cargos de liderança em serviços de saúde;
  • Experiência na implementação de processos, protocolos de qualidade e auditorias;
  • Curso de Auditor PALC será um diferencial;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado será considerado um diferencial;
  • Etapas do processo seletivo incluem entrevista com o gestor.

About Sabin

Referência em saúde, destacada pela gestão de pessoas e liderança feminina, o Grupo Sabin nasceu em Brasília há décadas, fruto da coragem de duas empreendedoras. Hoje, conta com cerca de 7.000 colaboradores, presente em 14 estados e no Distrito Federal, com 354 unidades, oferecendo serviços de saúde com excelência, inovação e responsabilidade socioambiental. O ecossistema de saúde do Grupo Sabin integra análises clínicas, diagnóstico por imagem, anatomia patológica, genômica, imunização e check-up executivo, além de serviços de atenção primária com a Amparo Saúde e a plataforma Rita Saúde, promovendo acesso à saúde com qualidade e eficiência. Em 2020, foi lançado o SkyHub.Bio, hub de inovação para promoção e desenvolvimento de startups na saúde. O Grupo mantém o Instituto Sabin, criado em 2005 para ações de impacto social, que já beneficiou mais de 1,6 milhão de pessoas e 902 organizações sociais.

Conheça nossos processos seletivos e vagas disponíveis nas unidades Sabin pelo Brasil. Investimos em processos formulados para atrair pessoas engajadas com nosso propósito e valores.

Fique atento e evite golpes! Não cobramos quaisquer valores para participação em nossos processos seletivos em qualquer etapa.

description:
Job description

Elaborar e controlar o “Planejamento de Marketing” e supervisionar o orçamento anual. Supervisionar ações e campanhas de endomarketing e realizar curadoria de conteúdos gráficos, vídeos e textos.   • Supervisionar a produção de materiais gráficos, digitais e físicos (formulários, adesivos, folders, identificações de salas, entre outros);

  • Elaborar o “Planejamento de Marketing” e supervisionar a execução das ações de campanhas planejadas, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e do orçamento anual;
  • Atuar junto aos demais Deptºs, para identificar problemas e oportunidades que o Deptº de Marketing poderá apoiar com soluções e inovações e desenvolver ações para as oportunidades identificadas;
  • Realizar visitas a clientes e parceiros da empresa, junto com Gestores e equipes do Deptº Comercial, para apoiar o processo de vendas, identificando oportunidades, traçando estratégias, ações e campanhas para inovação e soluções;
  • Assegurar o uso devido das marcas e a identidade visual da empresa dentro (formulários e materiais internos) e fora da empresa (material público e páginas institucionais);
  • Gerir pautas, horários, atribuir tarefas, supervisionar as atividades e desempenho da equipe de Marketing;
  • Desenvolver e implantar novos procedimentos do Deptº, treinar e capacitar a equipe em todas as etapas;
  • Fornecer informações sobre eventos e brindes, para o time de Compliance, a fim de que estes estejam em conformidade com o Código de Conduta, Políticas e normas diversas, estabelecidas pelo Deptº de Compliance.

Diferencial

  • Desejável possuir CNH (categoria B) ativa e veículo próprio;
  • Desejável experiência com análise de KPIs;
  • Desejável inglês nível intermediário.

This role ensures accuracy in case counts and budgets, surfaces performance insights, and creates scalable reporting solutions that empower the entire team.

The ideal candidate is mid-level, highly analytical, and able to take full ownership of results with minimal oversight. They are adept at spotting trends, building actionable reports, and anticipating issues before they become problems. Over time, this role may evolve into a companywide business analyst position, with broader responsibility for insights and reporting across teams.

What You'll Do

Client Reporting & Reconciliation

  • Case Data Reconciliation: Own the process of reconciling signed case counts between internal systems and client reports, resolving discrepancies independently.
  • Fund Reallocations: Accurately process client requests to move budgets across projects, ensuring all updates are reflected in reporting.

  • Issue Detection: Monitor conversion rates, lead quality, and profitability by lead type and field values to proactively spot risks and opportunities.

Client-Facing Support

  • Email Communication: Participate in client email threads to share reconciled numbers, reporting deliverables, and updates related to reallocations.
  • Light Client Interaction: Join occasional client calls to clarify data, while leaving strategic discussions to the Director of Client Services.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–6 years in business analysis, reporting, client operations, or related analytical roles. Experience in legal case acquisition or performance marketing is a plus.
  • Technical Skills: Master level of proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas) and reporting dashboards (e.g., Looker, Omni, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to slice/dice data, reconcile discrepancies, and extract actionable insights across multiple variables (lead type, conversion rates, profitability, etc.).
  • Automation & Tools: Comfortable building repeatable reports, dashboards, and using AI or automation to accelerate data comparison and analysis.
  • Ownership: Able to take responsibility for results with little oversight, quickly becoming the go-to person for reporting and analysis.
  • Communication: Clear, concise written skills for client-facing updates and internal reports.
  • Adaptability: Ability to learn new systems quickly and thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift rapidly.
  • Personal Attributes:
    • Extremely detail-oriented and accuracy-obsessed.
    • High ownership, proactive problem-solver who identifies issues before others see them.
    • Curious and driven to dig into data until key insights emerge.
    • Comfortable in a support role, enabling leadership to focus on higher-level strategy.
    • Growth-oriented, eager to expand from client-level reporting into companywide business analysis.

Benefits

  • Uncapped quarterly profit-sharing bonuses based on company performance
  • 100% company-paid monthly premiums for Fortune 500 level quality insurance plans for you and any/all dependents (US based employees):

Overview

We are seeking a Marketing Specialist to join the Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division of Crude Oil Sales & Marketing Dept (COSMD).

The Strategic Studies & Market Analysis Division is responsible for providing oil market analysis, market intelligence and data analytics, strategic studies and market research, as well as project management and coordination within the crude oil sales and marketing department.

Your primary role is to oversee and manage various marketing activities, drive marketing research initiatives, and optimize performance to support the company’s overall marketing strategies.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide expertise in a specialized area with crude oil placement strategy and market analysis.
  • Participate in analysis and strategy development that addresses short- and long-term needs, highly complex issues and challenges.
  • Mentor, train, and develop others to provide awareness of the complex concepts within crude oil markets.
  • Undertake complex studies within your developed area of expertise in crude oil placement strategy and market analysis that can impact the company’s present and future operations.
  • Monitor the development of existing and emerging market trends to forecast their viability and evolution over time.
  • Frequently direct and/or coordinate work task forces on special studies and consult directly with Executive Management on issues as they arise.
  • Provide expert advice and guidance on complex planning and analysis problems to senior planning and analytical personnel and to Executive Management.
  • Collaborate with partners and key internal and external stakeholders on low carbon value proposition, presentation of analytical results as well as support in establishing an organization focused on low carbon product.
  • Provide quantitative and qualitative analysis to support the areas of commercializing low carbon crude oil and low carbon products such as LCAF, SAF, Naphtha and others with focus on offsetting and carbon markets mechanisms.
  • Prepare and present plans, analyses, interpretations, conclusions and recommendations to Management and others on a broad range of petroleum market issues.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Environmental Science or equivalent from a recognized and approved program.
  • Advanced degree in economics, energy, or MBA is preferred.
  • Over 12 years of experience in oil and gas sustainability, Environment, Social & Governance (ESG) and carbon market industry.
  • Knowledge of carbon markets and environmental regulations related to GHG Emissions with understanding of the compliance carbon markets, voluntary carbon markets, baseline and crediting mechanisms, carbon-related trade measures and carbon pricing.
  • Extensive knowledge of global crude oil market balances and flows; pricing dynamics and structures; and methodologies of reporting agencies and exchange contracts.
  • Familiarity with refinery and petrochemicals, linear programming, and investment financial modeling is preferred.
  • Understanding of refining and refining economics.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Analista de Dados (BI) – Marketing e Produto

O que é a nstech?
A nstech é a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo, construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico. Nosso objetivo é conectar e transformar a cadeia logística, oferecendo centenas de soluções integradas em um único lugar. Acreditamos no poder da tecnologia para melhorar o mundo, reduzindo a emissão de CO2, acidentes e roubos.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Analista de Business Intelligence no time de Product Marketing. Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

title: CX - Customer Experience Brazil (São Paulo - Remote
description:
Pessoa Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente - Vagas Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD)

Brazil (São Paulo - Remote

Wellhub (antes, Gympass*) é uma plataforma de bem-estar corporativo que conecta os colaboradores aos melhores parceiros para exercício físico, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e rotina de sono, tudo incluso em uma assinatura que custa menos do que a individual de cada parceiro. Fundada em 2012 e sediada em Nova York, nossa empresa tem uma equipe crescente em 11 países. No Wellhub, você tem a oportunidade de construir a sua carreira em uma empresa de tecnologia de alto crescimento, que coloca o bem-estar como base da sua cultura e, além disso, contribui para fazer de toda empresa uma empresa de bem-estar.

*Grande novidade: Gympass agora é Wellhub!

Estamos felizes em anunciar nossa mudança de marca para Wellhub, um marco significativo na nossa jornada. Essa transformação reflete nossa evolução de “passe para academias” para uma solução ampla de bem-estar para colaboradores. Com nossa identidade atualizada, estamos prontos para embarcar em um capítulo novo e empolgante de crescimento e expansão. Estamos elevando nossa oferta, incluindo uma experiência completamente nova em nosso app e expansão da rede de nossos parceiros de bem-estar. Veja mais sobre isso aqui.

Por que temos um processo Afirmativo?

Esse é um programa de vagas afirmativas para Pessoa Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD). Nós acreditamos em fomentar a diversidade e nutrir um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todos têm acesso a oportunidades equitativas e alcançar o seu máximo potencial.
Para alcançar a nossa missão, é essencial garantir que todas as pessoas no Wellhub se sintam acolhidas, valorizadas e empoderadas.

A pessoa agente de CX é quem está na linha de frente do atendimento no Wellhub: responde dúvidas, resolve problemas e garante que cada interação com nossos usuários seja clara e acolhedora. Atuando dentro da área de Business Transformation, esse papel conecta o suporte diário à missão maior da empresa, ajudando a transformar processos internos em experiências simples e eficazes para milhões de pessoas que acessam bem-estar todos os dias.

Como Analista de CX, você será responsável por fornecer uma experiência de atendimento de alta qualidade. Trabalhará para a resolução de problemas e atendimento consultivo de usuários, clientes e parceiros através de diversos canais. Sua missão é garantir a confiança do cliente com a nossa marca a partir de interações eficientes, empáticas e profissionais para promover satisfação e fidelidade.

Dentro da área de Atendimento ao Cliente do Wellhub, atuamos em Tribos com foco no perfil específico do cliente. Neste programa teremos posições dentro dos times de: Risk and Fraud , Partners Experience (New Ventures e Partners) , End Users Experience (End User, Reclame Aqui e Social Media)

  • CX Risk and Fraud (Prevention): Você atuará como um "escudo protetor" do ecossistema Wellhub. O foco será analisar dados para identificar e mitigar fraudes, além de se comunicar de forma empática em casos delicados. Você será fundamental para garantir a integridade e a confiança em todas as interações.
  • Foco do Suporte: Fornecer suporte a usuários, parceiros e clientes em vários canais.
  • Análise de Risco: Analisar dados para tomar decisões sobre usuários com potencial de fraude e reportar comportamentos suspeitos que possam causar perdas financeiras à Wellhub.
  • CX New Ventures: Sua principal função será dar suporte direto a parceiros, terapeutas, personal trainers e usuários finais. Você resolverá questões técnicas e complexas em diversos canais para assegurar uma experiência de alta qualidade.
    • Foco do Suporte: Lidar com questões de parceiros e usuários finais, principalmente por e-mail, chat e WhatsApp.
    • Resolução de Problemas: Avaliar as necessidades dos clientes e escalar problemas para outros departamentos ou equipes técnicas quando necessário.
  • CX Partners: Neste papel, você dará suporte direto a parceiros e usuários finais, resolvendo questões técnicas e complexas, como dúvidas, através de vários canais com o objetivo de garantir uma experiência excepcional para o ecossistema dos nossos parceiros.
    • Foco do Suporte: Servir como o principal ponto de contato, oferecendo suporte a parceiros e usuários finais através de múltiplos canais como e-mail, chat e WhatsApp.
    • Gestão e Conformidade: Utilizar o CRM para fornecer informações precisas e manter a aderência aos procedimentos operacionais para um serviço de alta qualidade.
  • CX Reclame Aqui : Você será responsável por resolver tickets de usuários e parceiros com alto nível de fricção no canal Reclame Aqui. Seu objetivo é manter o selo RA-1000 da marca e elevar a reputação e o valor do Wellhub no mercado.
    • Foco do Suporte: Lidar com casos críticos via e-mail, WhatsApp e telefone, com foco em manter a imagem e reputação do Wellhub.
    • Métricas de Desempenho: Monitorar e respeitar KPIs operacionais como SLA de primeira resposta e Tempo de Resolução Total (FRT).
    • Conhecimento Específico: Conhecimento das métricas, regras e plataforma do Reclame Aqui, além de noções básicas do Código de Defesa do Consumidor (CDC).
  • CX Social Media : Você será encarregado de proporcionar a melhor experiência possível para todos os usuários do Wellhub nas redes sociais e em canais de avaliação, como Instagram, Twitter, Google Play Store e Reddit. O objetivo é garantir um serviço ao cliente extremamente satisfatório e ajudar a criar estratégias focadas no cliente.
    • Foco do Suporte: Gerenciar comentários e mensagens em canais como Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, Youtube, TikTok e comunidades como Reddit.
    • Monitoramento da Marca: Detectar oportunidades e possíveis crises de marca, engajando proativamente em menções ao Wellhub (social listening).
    • Estratégia e Conteúdo: Auxiliar na criação de uma estratégia de mídia social coesa, garantir que a voz da marca esteja sempre relevante e manter-se atualizado com as tendências digitais.
  • CX End User: Esta posição é responsável por auxiliar diretamente os Usuários Finais com dúvidas em vários canais, resolvendo problemas técnicos e complexos para garantir uma experiência excepcional.
    • Foco do Suporte: Gerenciar a comunicação com os clientes (e-mail, chat, telefone) para garantir sua satisfação, fornecendo soluções completas e precisas.
    • Métricas de Desempenho: Monitorar e respeitar KPIs operacionais como SLA de primeira resposta e Tempo de Resolução Total (FRT).
    • Conhecimentos Necessários: Utilizar o Zendesk para fornecer informações precisas ao cliente e manter a aderência aos procedimentos operacionais para um serviço de alta qualidade.
  • Ensino médio/técnico completo é o esperado, sendo uma formação universitária considerada um diferencial.
  • Experiência prévia com CX e suporte ao cliente por escrito em diferentes canais de atendimento e níveis de suporte.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas CRM como Zendesk ou Salesforce. Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados como Google Looker, Tableau ou Metabase é um diferencial.
  • Google Workspace (Google Docs, Sheets, etc.) é um diferencial.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gramática e informática.
  • Português nativo é obrigatório para todas as posições. Inglês intermediário é um diferencial.
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar 8 horas por dia, com escala de trabalho aos finais de semana (para as pessoas que atuarão especificamente em CX End User).

Mesmo que você não corresponda a 100% dos requisitos da vaga, candidate-se! Teremos o maior prazer em receber a sua inscrição e analisar o seu fit em nossa equipe. Lembre-se apenas de observar que a experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente por diferentes canais é obrigatória para estas funções específicas.

Somos uma empresa comprometida com a saúde e bem-estar das nossas pessoas colaboradoras. Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios Flex, que inclui:

WELLHUB: Você receberá o plano Gold+ do Wellhub de graça e outros planos premium com descontos significativos. Você vai poder acessar diversas academias e estúdios fitness, além de soluções de bem-estar, incluindo meditação, nutrição, saúde mental, rotina de sono e mais.

WELLNESS: Seguro Saúde, Odontológico e Seguro de Vida.

TRABALHO FLEXÍVEL : No Wellhub, a flexibilidade gera um ambiente de trabalho mais feliz, saudável e produtivo para todas as pessoas. Como uma empresa de trabalho flexível, oferecemos dois modelos: híbrido-flexível e remoto, e fazemos do escritório um lugar para colaboração e construção de equipe. O modelo para essa posição pode ser discutido com sua pessoa recrutadora e com a gerente de contratação. Você também vai receber um reembolso no primeiro mês de trabalho para equipar seu escritório remoto.

CRONOGRAMA FLEXÍVEL : Entendemos que, juntos, todos os Wellhubbers e suas pessoas líderes podem tomar as melhores decisões para seus escopos particulares. Isso inclui a flexibilidade para ajustar as horas de trabalho com base nos cronogramas pessoais, fuso horário e necessidades de negócio.

CRESCIMENTO PROFISSIONAL: Excelentes oportunidades de crescimento pessoal e profissional com foco no seu desenvolvimento.

CULTURA: Entre em uma atmosfera motivadora e de apoio constante, com pessoas de diversos cantos do mundo. Você vai construir parcerias com colegas de diversos países e fazer parte do sucesso de uma empresa de tecnologia que não para de crescer, que traz soluções revolucionárias no seu segmento. Aqui, a sua autonomia vai se transformar em um impacto duradouro no negócio e no mundo. Nossa cultura baseada em confiança, flexibilidade e integridade torna isso possível todos os dias. Entenda mais sobre ela em nossa página de carreiras .

FÉRIAS/DAY-OFF: Sabemos a importância de tirar um tempo para desconectar do trabalho e recarregar as energias. Por isso, nós oferecemos:

Férias após 6 meses + 3 dias de folga por ano + 1 dia de folga durante o mês do seu aniversário + 1 dia de folga a cada aniversário de casa (somando até 5 dias).

LICENÇA PARENTAL PAGA: Receber um novo filho é um dos momentos mais especiais da vida e nós queremos que as nossas pessoas colaboradoras possam tirar uma licença para aproveitar a família.

Fazemos parte do programa Empresa Cidadã e também oferecemos licença para pais adotivos.

title: Developer Relations (Americas)
description:
Overview

Runware is building a leading API for all AI. Our platform makes it easy for developers to add advanced media generation capabilities to their products in hours instead of months, without the burden of managing GPUs, scaling, or constant model updates. By combining custom hardware with optimized software and orchestration, we deliver unmatched speed, reliability, and cost efficiency across hundreds of thousands of models. Backed by top global investors, we're growing quickly and building a team to shape the future of AI development.

About The Role
We\'re looking for Developer Relations to be the technical voice connecting our media generation API with the developer community. You\'ll bridge the gap between our engineering team and the developers building on Runware—from indie creators to enterprise teams integrating our generation capabilities into their products.

First and foremost, you must be passionate about generative AI and able to demonstrate it through project links, technical content, open-source contributions, or other hands-on work. We\'re looking for builders with some development experience. You don\'t need to be a superstar engineer, but you should be comfortable writing and debugging code.

This is an intentionally broad role that will flex around your strengths. It could include creating educational content, debugging integrations, supporting developers, building SDKs and integrations, or representing Runware at events and hackathons. You might maintain SDKs or third-party integrations, build new integrations, or contribute workflow examples and tutorials. A key part of the role is bringing value to our ecosystem which could include being active in public — sharing your work, engaging with other developers, and making technical content visible across socials, forums, and communities. You\'ll help Runware have a strong presence where developers already are.

More than just a job title, this is an invitation to join a company that\'s spearheading the future of AI. We\'re looking for people who want to partner with us, explore their passion for AI, and help other developers succeed. Your technical credibility with developers matters most. Everything else is flexible.

Is this role a fit for you?

If you\'re unsure whether you tick every box below but you\'re excited by AI and have something to show, we\'d love to hear from you. This role is designed to flex around the right people. If you\'ve built projects, contributed to communities, or simply can\'t stop experimenting with generative AI, you already have what matters most. We are even open to freelancers who may just want to contribute in one specific area. Apply and let\'s explore how your passion can grow with Runware.

What This Role Could Entail

  • Write and share technical content — blog posts, guides, videos, and walkthroughs — and distribute it across socials, forums, and developer communities
  • Actively manage and grow our developer community across Discord, Reddit, and social platforms, including hosting office hours, AMAs, workshops, and spotlighting community projects
  • Represent Runware at conferences, hackathons, and developer events, and support inbound interest by helping developers go from first experiment to production usage
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for developers using our API across community channels such as Discord, GitHub, and forums, while surfacing documentation gaps and collaborating with the team to improve clarity
  • Maintain and build our SDKs, plugins, and third-party integrations like ComfyUI or Vercel, and create sample projects, code examples, and workflow tutorials

Requirements

  • First and foremost: you are extremely passionate about AI, particularly generative AI or media generation, and can demonstrate this through project links, technical content, open-source contributions, hackathons, or other hands-on work
  • Some development experience. Comfortable working with schemas, APIs, and full-stack concepts (backend and frontend). The exact languages or frameworks you\'ve used matter less than your ability to build and explain working solutions
  • Experience experimenting with AI technologies such as training LoRAs, building advanced workflows in ComfyUI, or integrating AI models into projects
  • A blend of coding ability and AI know-how. You can navigate developer tooling and generative AI workflows, even if you\'re not a senior specialist in either
  • Excellent technical writing skills. Able to explain complex concepts clearly for developers, and actively share that content across forums, socials, and developer communities
  • Active in developer ecosystems from AI/ML Discord servers and GitHub to hackathons, meetups, or developer events. Comfortable representing and amplifying technical work in public

Benefits

We\'re a remote-first team that comes together in person twice a year to plan, collaborate, and celebrate wins. Day to day we keep a few core hours for teamwork, but outside of that you set the schedule that helps you do your best work.

Our environment is fast-moving and ambitious. Big pushes are part of building category-defining products, but we balance that with flexible working, generous time off, and regular retreats so the team can stay sharp and motivated.

  • Generous paid time off - vacation, sick days, public holidays
  • Meaningful stock options - share in the upside you create
  • Remote-first setup - work from home anywhere we can employ you
  • Flexible hours - own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks
  • Family leave - paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time
  • Company retreats - twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations
